task: CNPG WAL archiving failure ran ~20h unnoticed (#600, PR #601). Enable CNPG metrics scraping in narwhal-db Cluster and kube-prometheus-stack PodMonitor discovery across all namespaces. Fix CNPGClusterNotHealthy to fire on collector unhealthy without absent(), add CNPGMetricsUnavailable for missing metrics, and add CNPGWALArchivingFailing for failed_count increase or stalled archival > 1800s. Pin with R326 promtool cases and mutations.

events.summary: Change only monitoring.enablePodMonitor in narwhal-db.yaml (minimal diff, avoiding other lanes' probe/resource edits), sync scripts/cluster/07-cnpg.sh, set podMonitorSelectorNilUsesHelmValues: false in prometheus-stack.yaml and 08-2-monitoring.sh, fix CNPGClusterNotHealthy and add CNPGMetricsUnavailable/CNPGWALArchivingFailing in prometheus-alerts.yaml. Deliberately left alone: postgresql parameters, storage/resources/affinity in narwhal-db.yaml, live cluster (read-only kubectl context narwhal only), git push/PR/merge.

narwhal-db.yaml had monitoring.enablePodMonitor: false and kube-prometheus-stack had podMonitorSelectorNilUsesHelmValues: true with matchLabels: {release: prometheus-stack}, so CNPG exporter port 9187 was never scraped. CNPGClusterNotHealthy combined cnpg_collector_up == 0 with absent(), causing constant false firing with empty $labels.cluster_name while real WAL archival failures went unnoticed for ~20h.

D-CNPG-MON: enablePodMonitor: true in narwhal-db.yaml and 07-cnpg.sh, podMonitorSelectorNilUsesHelmValues: false and empty podMonitorSelector/podMonitorNamespaceSelector in prometheus-stack.yaml and 08-2-monitoring.sh. D-CNPG-HEALTH-ALERT: CNPGClusterNotHealthy evaluates strictly on cnpg_collector_up == 0 for 5m, missing metrics handled by CNPGMetricsUnavailable for 15m. D-CNPG-WAL-ARCHIVE-ALERT: CNPGWALArchivingFailing evaluates increase of cnpg_pg_stat_archiver_failed_count[5m] > 0 or seconds_since_last_archival > 1800 with last_archived_time > 0 for 5m. Official CNPG 1.29 docs URL cited in comments.
